post.description:
Creates a new marker link connecting two markers on a map. Links define navigable paths between markers.

Example payload:
{
  "id": "<uuid>",
  "mapId": "<uuid>",
  "beginMarkerId": "<uuid>",
  "endMarkerId": "<uuid>",
  "isBiDirect": true,

}

isBiDirect.description: Whether the link allows travel in both directions

isCurve.description: Whether the link is a curve (uses control points)

phyCtrlPoints.description: JSON array of [x, y] control points for curved links in physical space (meters)

length.description: Length of the link in meters

put.description:
Updates an existing marker link. Only provided fields will be updated. Accepted fields: `beginMarkerId`, `endMarkerId`, `isBiDirect`, `isCurve`, `phyCtrlPoints`, `length`, `params`.

post.description:
Creates a new action within a mission. Actions are related via `nextActionId` and `parentActionId`. The `params` field is a JSON string whose structure depends on the action `type`.

Example payload:
{
  "id": "<uuid>",
  "missionId": "<uuid>",
  "name": "Move to A",
  "type": "MOVE_TO_POINT",
  "params": "{\'markerId\':\'<uuid>\'}",
  "webhookParams": "{\'host\':\'<url>\'}"
}

Action Types & Params


Navigation


MOVE_TO_POINT - Freely navigate the AMR to a specific point.
Params: `markerId` (target marker UUID), `x`/`y`/`yaw` (optional position overrides in meters/radians, default to marker values), `xyTolerance` (meters, default 0.2), `yawTolerance` (radians, default 0.1; forced to π for WAYPOINT markers), `vxMax` (m/s, default 0.5), `vwMax` (rad/s, default 0.5).
{
  "markerId": "<uuid>",
  "x": 1.0,
  "y": 2.0,
  "yaw": 0.0,
  "xyTolerance": 0.2,
  "yawTolerance": 0.1,
  "vxMax": 0.5,
  "vwMax": 0.5
}

FOLLOW_PATH - Follow the shortest path between two markers via marker links.
Params: `beginMarkerId`/`endMarkerId` (start and end marker UUIDs), `xyTolerance` (meters, default 0.2), `yawTolerance` (radians, default 0.1; forced to π for WAYPOINT markers).
{
  "beginMarkerId": "<uuid>",
  "endMarkerId": "<uuid>",
  "xyTolerance": 0.2,
  "yawTolerance": 0.1,
}

MOVE_RELATIVELY - Move the AMR relative to its current position.
Params: `x` (meters, default 0), `y` (meters, default 0), `yaw` (radians, default 0), `vxMax` (m/s, default 0.5), `vwMax` (rad/s, default 0.5).
{
  "x": 0.0,
  "y": 0.0,
  "yaw": 0.0,
  "vxMax": 0.5,
  "vwMax": 0.5
}

DOCK_VL_MARKER - Dock the AMR to a marker. The referenced marker must have `dockOffsetX`, `dockOffsetY`, `dockOffsetYaw`, and `vlMarkerType` set in its own params.
Params: `markerId` (marker UUID), `stopSignalIndex` (default -1), `transitAhead` (meters, default 0).
{
  "markerId": "<uuid>",
  "stopSignalIndex": -1,
  "transitAhead": 0
}

Localization


CHANGE_MAP - Switch the active map on the AMR.
Params: `mapId` (target map UUID).
{
  "mapId": "<uuid>"
}

RELOCALIZE - Relocalize the AMR at a specific pose on the current map.
Params: `markerId` (reference marker UUID), `x`/`y`/`yaw` (optional position overrides in meters/radians, default to marker values).
{
  "markerId": "<uuid>",
  "x": 1.0,
  "y": 2.0,
  "yaw": 0.0
}

Flow control


WAIT - Pause execution for a fixed duration.
Params: `duration` (seconds, default 5).
{
  "duration": 5
}

PAUSE - Pause mission execution until manually resumed. No params required.

Mission Boundaries


MISSION_START - Entry point of a mission. Every mission must have exactly one. Its `nextActionId` points to the first executable action. No params required.

MISSION_END - Terminates a mission branch. No params required.

nextActionId.description: ID of the next action in the linked list

parentActionId.description: ID of the parent action (for nested flow-control actions)

webhookParams.description: JSON string of webhook parameters called on action completion

put.description:
Updates an existing action. Only provided fields will be updated. Accepted fields: `name`, `nextActionId`, `parentActionId`, `params`, `webhookParams`.

Example payload:
{
  "name": "Move to A"
}

post.summary: Simple API for mission creation and execution
post.description:
One-shot endpoint that creates (or reuses) a named mission on the active map, wires the provided action list into a linked-list execution chain, and immediately queues it for execution.

Example payload:
{
  "name": "Quick Delivery",
  "actions": [
  {"type": "MOVE_TO_POINT", "name": "Go to A", "params": {"markerName": "M0001"}},
  {"type": "WAIT", "name": "Wait 5s", "params": {"duration": 5}},
  {"type": "FOLLOW_PATH", "name": "Return to base", "params": {"beginMarkerName": "M0001", "endMarkerName": "M0002"}}
  ]
}

Preconditions (returns 400 if violated)

  • A map must currently be activated.
  • No mission may be running or queued - the execution queue must be empty.

Mission creation / reuse

If a mission whose `name` matches the request body already exists on the active map, it is reused and its actions are fully overwritten. Otherwise a new mission is created. The default name is `[Quick Mission]` when `name` is omitted.

Marker name resolution

Inside each action's `params` object you may use human-readable names instead of UUIDs - they are resolved against the markers of the active map:
  • `markerName` resolved to `markerId` (used by `MOVE_TO_POINT`, `DOCK_VL_MARKER`, `RELOCALIZE`)
  • `beginMarkerName` resolved to `beginMarkerId` (used by `FOLLOW_PATH`)
  • `endMarkerName` resolved to `endMarkerId` (used by `FOLLOW_PATH`)
If the name does not match any marker, the resolved ID will be `undefined`; no error is thrown at this stage.

Supported action types & params

Navigation

MOVE_TO_POINT - Freely navigate the AMR to a specific point.
Params: `markerId` or `markerName` (target marker), `x`/`y`/`yaw` (optional position overrides in meters/radians, default to marker values), `xyTolerance` (meters, default 0.2), `yawTolerance` (radians, default 0.1; forced to π for WAYPOINT markers), `vxMax` (m/s, default 0.5), `vwMax` (rad/s, default 0.5).

FOLLOW_PATH - Follow the shortest path between two markers via marker links.
Params: `beginMarkerId`/`beginMarkerName` (start marker), `endMarkerId`/`endMarkerName` (end marker), `xyTolerance` (meters, default 0.2), `yawTolerance` (radians, default 0.1; forced to π for WAYPOINT markers).

MOVE_RELATIVELY - Move the AMR relative to its current position.
Params: `x` (meters, default 0), `y` (meters, default 0), `yaw` (radians, default 0), `vxMax` (m/s, default 0.5), `vwMax` (rad/s, default 0.5).

DOCK_VL_MARKER - Dock the AMR to a marker. The referenced marker must have `dockOffsetX`, `dockOffsetY`, `dockOffsetYaw`, and `vlMarkerType` set in its own params.
Params: `markerId` or `markerName` (marker), `stopSignalIndex` (default -1), `transitAhead` (meters, default 0).

Localization

CHANGE_MAP - Switch the active map on the AMR.
Params: `mapId` (target map UUID).

RELOCALIZE - Relocalize the AMR at a specific pose on the current map.
Params: `markerId` or `markerName` (reference marker), `x`/`y`/`yaw` (optional position overrides in meters/radians, default to marker values).

Flow control

WAIT - Pause execution for a fixed duration.
Params: `duration` (seconds, default 5).

PAUSE - Pause mission execution until manually resumed. No params required.
